tool_schemas.name: getwalletnfts
tool_schemas.description: Returns the NFTs owned by a given wallet on the specified chain, optionally filtered to specific NFT contract addresses, with numeric fields formatted per `format` and optional normalized metadata and media items. Results are paginated with `limit` and an opaque `cursor` returned in the response for the next page; when `excludeSpam` is true we omit items flagged or suspected as spam. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an unsupported `chain`, invalid `address`, invalid `tokenAddresses`, or out-of-range `limit`; UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_ALLOWED when your API key cannot access this chain or endpoint; RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your plan’s request limits.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. "eth", "polygon").

address.description: Wallet address to fetch NFTs for.

limit.description: Maximum number of NFTs to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

normalizeMetadata.description: Whether to return normalized metadata fields when available.

mediaItems.description: Whether to include media items (images/animation) when available.

excludeSpam.description: Whether to exclude NFTs marked or suspected as spam.

tokenAddresses.description: Optional list of NFT contract addresses to filter results by.

tool_schemas.name: getmultiplenfts
tool_schemas.description: Returns metadata for up to 25 NFTs on a given chain, where each entry is identified by `token_address` and `token_id`, and may include on-chain details plus off-chain metadata, market data (such as floor price), rarity, and media when available. The response is a single, non-paginated batch corresponding to the submitted `tokens` array, with optional normalized metadata and media items. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `tokens` is empty, exceeds 25 items, contains malformed addresses or token ids, or if `chain` is unsupported; NOT_FOUND when an NFT identifier cannot be resolved or is not indexed for that chain; UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_ALLOWED and RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. "eth", "polygon").

tokens.description: Array (max 25) of NFT identifiers to fetch metadata for.

normalizeMetadata.description: Whether to return normalized metadata fields when available.

mediaItems.description: Whether to include media items (images/animation) when available.

tool_schemas.name: getwalletnftcollections
tool_schemas.description: Returns the NFT collections held by a given wallet on the specified chain, with collection-level metadata and market fields when available and optional normalized metadata. Results are paginated with `limit` and `cursor`, and `excludeSpam` removes collections flagged or suspected as spam. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an unsupported `chain`, invalid `address`, invalid cursor, or out-of-range `limit`; UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_ALLOWED if your key lacks access; RATE_LIMITED when you exceed request quotas.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. "eth", "polygon").

address.description: Wallet address to fetch NFT collections for.

limit.description: Maximum number of collections to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

excludeSpam.description: Whether to exclude collections marked or suspected as spam.

normalizeMetadata.description: Whether to return normalized metadata fields when available.

tool_schemas.name: getcontractnfts
tool_schemas.description: Returns NFTs from a given NFT contract (collection) on the specified chain, including token ids in the requested `format` plus metadata/rarity/market fields and optional media when available. Results are paginated with `limit` and `cursor`, and `excludeSpam` omits tokens flagged or suspected as spam. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an unsupported `chain`, invalid contract `address`, invalid cursor, or out-of-range `limit`; NOT_FOUND when the contract is not indexed or does not exist on that chain; UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_ALLOWED and RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. "eth", "polygon").

address.description: NFT contract address (collection) to fetch NFTs for.

limit.description: Maximum number of NFTs to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

normalizeMetadata.description: Whether to return normalized metadata fields when available.

mediaItems.description: Whether to include media items (images/animation) when available.

excludeSpam.description: Whether to exclude NFTs marked or suspected as spam.

tool_schemas.name: getnftowners
tool_schemas.description: Returns owners for NFTs from the specified contract on the given chain; when `tokenId` is provided it returns owners for that specific token, otherwise it returns owners across the entire contract. Results are paginated with `limit` and `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an unsupported `chain`, invalid contract `address`, invalid `tokenId`, invalid cursor, or out-of-range `limit`; NOT_FOUND when the contract (or the specific token when `tokenId` is provided) cannot be found or is not indexed; UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_ALLOWED and RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. "eth", "polygon").

address.description: NFT contract address to identify owners for.

tokenId.description: Optional token id to get owners of a specific NFT (if omitted, returns owners across the contract).

limit.description: Maximum number of owners to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: getnftcontracttransfers
tool_schemas.description: Returns transfer events for an NFT contract on the specified chain, optionally filtered by `tokenId` and by an ISO-8601 time window using `fromDate` and `toDate`. Results are paginated with `limit` and `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an unsupported `chain`, invalid contract `address`, invalid `tokenId`, malformed dates, `fromDate` after `toDate`, invalid cursor, or out-of-range `limit`; NOT_FOUND when the contract (or token if specified) is not indexed; UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_ALLOWED and RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. "eth", "polygon").

address.description: NFT contract address to fetch transfers for.

tokenId.description: Optional token id to filter transfers to a specific NFT.

fromDate.description: Filter transfers occurring at or after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

toDate.description: Filter transfers occurring at or before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of transfers to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: getnftbycontracttraits
tool_schemas.description: Returns NFTs within a given contract on the specified chain whose metadata matches all provided `traits` (each with `trait_type` and `value`), with optional normalized metadata and media items. Results are paginated with `limit` and `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an unsupported `chain`, invalid contract `address`, empty or malformed `traits`, invalid cursor, or out-of-range `limit`; NOT_FOUND when the contract is not indexed or trait search is unavailable due to missing metadata for the collection; UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_ALLOWED and RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. "eth", "polygon").

address.description: NFT contract address to search within.

traits.description: Trait filters to match NFTs by attributes.

trait_type.description: Trait name (attribute key) to filter by.

limit.description: Maximum number of NFTs to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

normalizeMetadata.description: Whether to return normalized metadata fields when available.

mediaItems.description: Whether to include media items (images/animation) when available.

tool_schemas.name: getnfttraitsbycollection
tool_schemas.description: Returns the distinct trait keys and values observed for NFTs in the specified collection on the given chain, suitable for building attribute filters and discovery. The response is not paginated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an unsupported `chain` or invalid contract `address`; NOT_FOUND when the contract is not indexed or has no traitable metadata available; UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_ALLOWED and RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. "eth", "polygon").

address.description: NFT contract address (collection) to explore traits for.

tool_schemas.name: getnfttrades
tool_schemas.description: Returns indexed trade events for the given NFT contract on the specified chain, optionally filtered by `marketplace` and an ISO-8601 time window using `from_date` and `to_date`. Results are paginated with `limit` (1–100) and an opaque `cursor` returned in the response for subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an unsupported `chain`, invalid contract `address`, malformed dates, `from_date` after `to_date`, invalid cursor, or `limit` outside 1–100; NOT_FOUND when the contract is not indexed; UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_ALLOWED and RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id or Moralis chain key).

address.description: NFT contract address (0x-prefixed for EVM).

marketplace.description: Filter trades by marketplace name (as indexed in events.marketplace).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of trades to return.

tool_schemas.name: getnfttradesbytoken
tool_schemas.description: Get NFT trades for a specific NFT by specifying a contract addres and token ID.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id or Moralis chain key).

address.description: NFT contract address (0x-prefixed for EVM).

token_id.description: NFT token id (as a string, supports large integers).

marketplace.description: Filter trades by marketplace name (as indexed in events.marketplace).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of trades to return.

tool_schemas.name: getnfttradesbywallet
tool_schemas.description: Returns indexed NFT trade events involving the given wallet on the selected chain, optionally filtered by marketplace and time window, sorted by block_timestamp in the requested order. The response is paginated with limit and an opaque cursor; pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if chain/address are invalid, limit/order/dates are out of range or from_date > to_date, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if your API key cannot access the chain or endpoint, NOT_FOUND if the chain is unsupported, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id or Moralis chain key).

address.description: Wallet address to fetch NFT trades for (0x-prefixed for EVM).

marketplace.description: Filter trades by marketplace name (as indexed in events.marketplace).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of trades to return.

tool_schemas.name: getnftbulkcontractmetadata
tool_schemas.description: Returns contract-level metadata for up to 25 NFT contract addresses on the selected chain (e.g., name, symbol and any available enrichment such as off-chain details and optional floor price fields). Results are returned in request order and may be paginated with limit and cursor when supplied by the backend; use the returned cursor to retrieve remaining contracts. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any address is malformed, addresses exceeds 25, or limit is outside 1–25, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials, NOT_FOUND if the chain is unsupported, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed plan quotas.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id or Moralis chain key).

addresses.description: List of NFT contract addresses (max 25; 0x-prefixed for EVM).

include_floor_price.description: Whether to include floor price fields when available.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response (if backend paginates results).

limit.description: Maximum number of contracts to return (max 25).

tool_schemas.name: getnftmetadata
tool_schemas.description: Returns metadata for a single NFT (contract address + token_id) on the selected chain, including on-chain fields and any available off-chain/enriched attributes (and normalized fields when normalize_metadata is true). This endpoint returns a single object (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid chain/address/token_id format, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials, NOT_FOUND if the contract/token_id is not indexed or the chain is unsupported, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id or Moralis chain key).

address.description: NFT contract address (0x-prefixed for EVM).

token_id.description: NFT token id (as a string, supports large integers).

normalize_metadata.description: Whether to normalize/standardize off-chain metadata fields if available.

tool_schemas.name: getnfttransfers
tool_schemas.description: Returns indexed transfer events for the specified NFT (contract address + token_id) on the selected chain, optionally filtered by timestamp window, sorted by block_timestamp in the requested order. The response is paginated with limit and cursor; provide the cursor from the previous response to continue. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are invalid (including from_date > to_date or limit/order out of bounds), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials, NOT_FOUND if the NFT or chain is not indexed/supported, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed plan quotas.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id or Moralis chain key).

address.description: NFT contract address (0x-prefixed for EVM).

token_id.description: NFT token id (as a string, supports large integers).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of transfers to return.

tool_schemas.name: getnfttokenidowners
tool_schemas.description: Lists current owner records for the specified NFT (contract address + token_id) on the selected chain, typically including each owner wallet and balance/quantity where applicable. The response is paginated using limit and cursor; pass cursor to fetch subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid chain/address/token_id or limit out of bounds, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials, NOT_FOUND if the NFT or chain is not indexed/supported, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id or Moralis chain key).

address.description: NFT contract address (0x-prefixed for EVM).

token_id.description: NFT token id (as a string, supports large integers).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of owner records to return.

tool_schemas.name: getnftcontractsaleprices
tool_schemas.description: Returns aggregated sale-price statistics for all NFTs in the given contract over the last N days on the selected chain, optionally restricted to a single marketplace, including last/low/high/average sale and total trades in the period. This is an aggregate response (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if days is outside 1–3650 or inputs are malformed, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials, NOT_FOUND if the contract is not indexed or the chain is unsupported, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed plan quotas.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id or Moralis chain key).

address.description: NFT contract address (0x-prefixed for EVM).

days.description: Lookback window in days to aggregate sale price statistics.

marketplace.description: Filter sale price stats to a single marketplace name (as indexed in events.marketplace).

tool_schemas.name: getnftsaleprices
tool_schemas.description: Returns aggregated sale-price statistics for the specified NFT (contract address + token_id) over the requested window, including last/low/high/average sale and total trades, optionally filtered by marketplace. If from_date and to_date are provided, the window is defined by those timestamps; otherwise days is used as the lookback window (ending at to_date when provided, or now). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid inputs (including from_date > to_date or days out of 1–3650), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials, NOT_FOUND if the NFT is not indexed or the chain is unsupported, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

address.description: NFT collection contract address.

token_id.description: NFT token id within the collection.

days.description: Number of days to look back for sales.

marketplace.description: Optional marketplace filter (as indexed on events.marketplace).

from_date.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for the sales window; overrides days if provided with to_date.

to_date.description: End timestamp (exclusive) for the sales window; defaults to now.

tool_schemas.name: getswapsbytokenaddress
tool_schemas.description: Returns indexed DEX swap events involving the specified ERC20 token on the selected chain, optionally filtered by block range and/or timestamp range, sorted by block_number/log_index in the requested order. The response is paginated with limit and cursor; supply the returned cursor to continue listing swaps. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if token_address/chain are invalid, ranges are inconsistent (e.g., from_block > to_block or from_date > to_date) or limit/order are out of bounds, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials, NOT_FOUND if the token/chain is not indexed/supported, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed plan quotas.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

token_address.description: ERC20 token contract address to fetch swaps for.

from_block.description: Start block number (inclusive) to filter swaps.

to_block.description: End block number (inclusive) to filter swaps.

limit.description: Maximum number of swap events to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: gettokenholders
tool_schemas.description: Returns holder analytics for the specified ERC20 token on the selected chain, including total holders and aggregated holder-supply metrics, with optional trend, distribution, and acquisition sections computed over the requested lookback window. This is an aggregate response (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if token_address/chain are invalid or days is outside the allowed range for requested metrics, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials, NOT_FOUND if the token/chain is not indexed/supported, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed plan quotas.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

include_trends.description: Whether to include holder trends metrics in the response.

include_distribution.description: Whether to include holder distribution breakdown in the response.

include_acquisition.description: Whether to include holder acquisition metrics in the response.

days.description: Lookback window in days for computed trend/acquisition metrics.

to_block.description: Compute stats at a specific historical block (if supported by index).

tool_schemas.name: gethistoricaltokenholders
tool_schemas.description: Track changes in the holder base of an ERC20 token over time. Supports timeseries data for total holders as well as change metrics such as holder distribution and holder acquisition.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

from_date.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for the timeseries window.

to_date.description: End timestamp (exclusive) for the timeseries window.

interval.description: Bucket size for the holder timeseries.

limit.description: Maximum number of buckets to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: getmultipletokenprices
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest price (or the price at `to_block` when provided) for up to 100 ERC‑20 contracts on the given `chain`, quoted in the chain’s native currency and USD, and may enrich each result with the requested `include` fields (e.g., metadata, logo, liquidity, market) while optionally filtering illiquid assets via `exclude_low_liquidity`. The response is a single (non-paginated) array aligned to the submitted `tokens` list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chain` is invalid, the `tokens` array is empty/over 100, a token entry is missing `token_address`, `to_block` is negative, or `include` contains unsupported values; raises NOT_FOUND when a token contract cannot be resolved on the specified chain (or the requested `exchange` source is unknown for that chain); raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient API credentials and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate or plan quotas are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

to_block.description: Historical block number to price at (if omitted, returns latest).

exchange.description: DEX/exchange identifier to source the price from (if applicable).

include.description: Optional list of extra fields to include per token.

exclude_low_liquidity.description: Whether to exclude tokens below the service's liquidity threshold.

tool_schemas.name: gettokenowners
tool_schemas.description: Lists top owners for an ERC‑20 `token_address` on `chain`, returning balances and ownership percentages sorted by `order`, and optionally enriching each owner with known entities/labels when `include_entities` is true. Results are cursor-paginated using `limit` (max 500) and `cursor`, and may be filtered by `min_percentage` to only include owners at or above the given threshold. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid `chain`/`token_address`, invalid `order`, `limit` outside 1–500, `min_percentage` outside 0–100, or an invalid/expired `cursor`; raises NOT_FOUND if the token does not exist on the specified chain; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient API credentials and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate or quota limits are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

limit.description: Maximum number of top owners to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

min_percentage.description: Minimum ownership percentage threshold to include an owner.

include_entities.description: Whether to enrich owners with known entities/labels.

tool_schemas.name: gettokenmetadata
tool_schemas.description: Returns ERC‑20 contract metadata for up to 100 addresses on the given `chain`, including on-chain fields (name, symbol, decimals) and, when available, additional enrichments such as logo/off-chain metadata, total supply, categories, and spam status. The response is a single (non-paginated) list of metadata objects for the requested `addresses`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chain` is invalid, `addresses` is empty/over 100, or any address is malformed; raises NOT_FOUND when an address cannot be resolved as a token contract on the specified chain; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient API credentials and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate or quota limits are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

addresses.description: One or more ERC20 contract addresses to fetch metadata for.

tool_schemas.name: gettokencategories
tool_schemas.description: Lists ERC‑20 token categories available for the specified `chain`, optionally filtered by the search query `q`. Results are cursor-paginated via `limit` (max 1000) and `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid `chain`, `limit` outside 1–1000, or an invalid/expired `cursor`; raises NOT_FOUND if the chain is unsupported for categories; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient API credentials and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate or quota limits are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

limit.description: Maximum number of categories to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

q.description: Search query to filter categories by name.

tool_schemas.name: gettokentransfers
tool_schemas.description: Returns ERC‑20 transfer events for the token identified by `contract_address_id` on `chain_id`, ordered by block number descending (newest first), with optional filtering by block range (`from_block`/`to_block`) and/or time range (`from_date`/`to_date`), and optional inclusion of event metadata when `include_metadata` is true. Results are cursor-paginated using `limit` (max 100) and `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chain_id` or `contract_address_id` do not match the required id formats, if `from_block`/`to_block` are negative or inconsistent, if `from_date`/`to_date` are invalid or inconsistent, if `limit` is outside 1–100, or if `cursor` is invalid/expired; raises NOT_FOUND if the chain or contract id does not resolve; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient API credentials and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate or quota limits are exceeded.

chain_id.description: Chain id to query (Moralis internal chain id).

contract_address_id.description: Address id of the ERC20 token contract to fetch transfers for.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of transfers to return.

include_metadata.description: Whether to include event metadata payloads when available.

tool_schemas.name: getnativebalancesforaddresses
tool_schemas.description: Returns the native token balance for each address in `address_ids` on `chain_id`, using `block_number` when provided (otherwise the latest indexed state), and optionally includes an estimated USD value when `include_usd_price` is true. The response is a single (non-paginated) list aligned to the input `address_ids` (max 100). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chain_id` or any `address_ids` entry is not a valid internal id, if `address_ids` is empty/over 100, or if `block_number` is negative; raises NOT_FOUND if the chain id or any address id cannot be resolved; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient API credentials and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate or quota limits are exceeded.

chain_id.description: Chain id to query (Moralis internal chain id).

address_ids.description: List of wallet address ids to fetch native balances for.

block_number.description: Optional block number to query balances at (latest if omitted).

include_usd_price.description: Whether to include an estimated USD value using latest available native token price.

tool_schemas.name: getwalletapprovals
tool_schemas.description: Lists ERC‑20 approval allowances for `wallet_address_id` on `chain_id`, optionally filtered to a single token (`token_contract_address_id`), a single spender (`spender_address_id`), and/or a `status` of confirmed or pending. Results are cursor-paginated via `limit` (max 100) and `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any id does not match the required format, if `status` is not one of the allowed values, if `limit` is outside 1–100, or if `cursor` is invalid/expired; raises NOT_FOUND if the chain id or wallet/token/spender ids do not resolve; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient API credentials and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate or quota limits are exceeded.

chain_id.description: Chain id to query (Moralis internal chain id).

wallet_address_id.description: Wallet address id to list token approvals for.

token_contract_address_id.description: Optional ERC20 contract address id to filter approvals to a single token.

spender_address_id.description: Optional spender address id to filter approvals to a single spender.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of approvals to return.

tool_schemas.name: getwallethistory
tool_schemas.description: Returns decoded, categorized, and summarized transaction history records for `wallet_address_id` on `chain_id`, optionally constrained by block/date ranges and optionally including internal transfers, NFT transfers, and ERC‑20 transfers based on the include flags. Results are cursor-paginated using `limit` (max 100), `cursor`, and `order` to control sort direction for the history stream. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any id is invalid, if `from_block`/`to_block` or `from_date`/`to_date` are invalid or inconsistent, if `limit` is outside 1–100, if `order` is not supported, or if `cursor` is invalid/expired; raises NOT_FOUND if the chain id or wallet id does not resolve; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient API credentials and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate or quota limits are exceeded.

chain_id.description: Chain id to query (Moralis internal chain id).

wallet_address_id.description: Wallet address id to fetch decoded transaction history for.

include_nft_transfers.description: Whether to include NFT transfer events in the history view.

include_token_transfers.description: Whether to include ERC20 transfer events in the history view.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of history records to return.

order.description: Sort order by block number (default newest first).

tool_schemas.name: getwalletnetworth
tool_schemas.description: Calculate the total net worth of a wallet in USD, with options to exclude spam tokens for accuracy. Options to query cross-chain using the `chains` parameter, as well as additional options to exclude spam tokens, low-liquidity tokens and inactive tokens.

wallet_address_id.description: Wallet address id to calculate net worth for.

chains.description: List of chain ids to include in the cross-chain net worth calculation.

exclude_spam.description: Whether to exclude tokens marked as suspected_spam/spam.

exclude_low_liquidity.description: Whether to exclude tokens with very low or missing liquidity metrics.

exclude_inactive.description: Whether to exclude tokens with status not equal to active.

min_liquidity_usd.description: Minimum liquidity_usd threshold for tokens included in net worth.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def getblock(chain_id, block_hash, include_transactions=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0525000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0525000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "getblock"

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log(status, error=None, meta=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        logs.append({
            "id": f"mor_req_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{len(logs)+1}",
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "status": status,
            "timestamp": _now(),
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "chain_id": chain_id,
            "credential_id": None,
            "error": error,
            "meta": meta or {},
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    if not isinstance(chain_id, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"^mor_chain_[0-9A-Z]{3,}$", chain_id):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "chain_id must match ^mor_chain_[0-9A-Z]{3,}$", field="chain_id")
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e
    if not isinstance(block_hash, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"^(0x)?[A-Fa-f0-9]{64}$", block_hash.strip()):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "block_hash must match ^(0x)?[A-Fa-f0-9]{64}$", field="block_hash")
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e
    if include_transactions is not None and not isinstance(include_transactions, bool):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "include_transactions must be a boolean", field="include_transactions")
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e
    include_transactions = False if include_transactions is None else include_transactions

    chains = _load("chains.json")
    if not isinstance(chains, list):
        chains = []
    if not any(isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("id") == chain_id for c in chains):
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "chain_id not found", chain_id=chain_id)
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e

    bh = block_hash.strip().lower()
    if not bh.startswith("0x"):
        bh = "0x" + bh

    events = _load("events.json")
    if not isinstance(events, list):
        events = []

    # Find block event by hash on chain (prefer confirmed, but allow any status if only one exists)
    block_events = [e for e in events if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("chain_id") == chain_id and e.get("event_type") == "block" and isinstance(e.get("block_hash"), str) and e.get("block_hash").lower() == bh]
    if not block_events:
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "block hash not found on this chain", chain_id=chain_id, block_hash=bh)
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e
    block_event = next((e for e in block_events if e.get("status") == "confirmed"), None) or block_events[0]

    bn = block_event.get("block_number")
    ts = block_event.get("block_timestamp")
    status = block_event.get("status")

    # Transactions in that block: events with same block_number, have transaction_hash, and not event_type='block'
    txs = []
    if include_transactions:
        seen = set()
        for ev in events:
            if not isinstance(ev, dict):
                continue
            if ev.get("chain_id") != chain_id:
                continue
            if ev.get("event_type") == "block":
                continue
            if bn is not None and ev.get("block_number") != bn:
                continue
            th = ev.get("transaction_hash")
            if not isinstance(th, str) or not th:
                continue
            if th in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(th)
            txs.append({
                "transaction_hash": th,
                "block_number": ev.get("block_number"),
                "block_timestamp": ev.get("block_timestamp"),
                "status": ev.get("status"),
            })
        # deterministic ordering
        txs.sort(key=lambda r: (r.get("transaction_hash") or ""))

    resp = {
        "chain_id": chain_id,
        "block_hash": bh,
        "block_number": bn,
        "block_timestamp": ts,
        "status": status,
        "transactions": txs if include_transactions else None,
    }
    _log("ok", meta={"include_transactions": include_transactions, "transactions": len(txs) if include_transactions else 0})
    return resp

def getnftfloorpricebycontract(chain_id, contract_address_id, include_metadata=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0525000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0525000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "getnftfloorpricebycontract"

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log(status, error=None, meta=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        logs.append({
            "id": f"mor_req_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{len(logs)+1}",
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "status": status,
            "timestamp": _now(),
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "chain_id": chain_id,
            "credential_id": None,
            "error": error,
            "meta": meta or {},
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    if not isinstance(chain_id, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"^mor_chain_[0-9A-Z]{3,}$", chain_id):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "chain_id must match ^mor_chain_[0-9A-Z]{3,}$", field="chain_id")
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e
    if not isinstance(contract_address_id, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"^mor_addr_[0-9A-Z]{3,}$", contract_address_id):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "contract_address_id must match ^mor_addr_[0-9A-Z]{3,}$", field="contract_address_id")
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e
    if include_metadata is not None and not isinstance(include_metadata, bool):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "include_metadata must be boolean", field="include_metadata")
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e
    include_metadata = bool(include_metadata) if include_metadata is not None else False

    chains = _load("chains.json")
    if not isinstance(chains, list):
        chains = []
    if not any(isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("id") == chain_id for c in chains):
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "chain_id not found", chain_id=chain_id)
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e

    assets = _load("assets.json")
    if not isinstance(assets, list):
        assets = []

    col = next((a for a in assets if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("chain_id") == chain_id and a.get("asset_type") == "nft_collection" and a.get("contract_address_id") == contract_address_id), None)
    if not col:
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "NFT collection not found for chain_id/contract_address_id", chain_id=chain_id, contract_address_id=contract_address_id)
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e

    resp = {
        "chain_id": chain_id,
        "contract_address_id": contract_address_id,
        "asset_id": col.get("id"),
        "floor_price_native": col.get("floor_price_native"),
        "floor_price_usd": col.get("floor_price_usd"),
        "floor_price_refreshed_at": col.get("floor_price_refreshed_at"),
    }
    if include_metadata:
        resp["metadata"] = {
            "name": col.get("name"),
            "symbol": col.get("symbol"),
            "logo_url": col.get("logo_url"),
            "metadata": col.get("metadata"),
            "spam_status": col.get("spam_status"),
            "status": col.get("status"),
        }
    _log("ok", meta={"include_metadata": include_metadata})
    return resp

tool_schemas.implementation:
def getdiscoverytoken(chain, token_address, includeMetadata=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0525000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0525000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "getdiscoverytoken"

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log(status, error=None, meta=None, chain_id=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        logs.append({
            "id": f"mor_req_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{len(logs)+1}",
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "status": status,
            "timestamp": _now(),
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "chain_id": chain_id,
            "credential_id": None,
            "error": error,
            "meta": meta or {},
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    if not isinstance(chain, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"^mor_chain_[A-Za-z0-9]+$", chain):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "chain must match ^mor_chain_[A-Za-z0-9]+$", field="chain")
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e
    if not isinstance(token_address, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$", token_address):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "token_address must match ^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$", field="token_address")
        _log("error", e["error"], chain_id=chain)
        return e
    if includeMetadata is not None and not isinstance(includeMetadata, bool):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "includeMetadata must be boolean", field="includeMetadata")
        _log("error", e["error"], chain_id=chain)
        return e
    includeMetadata = bool(includeMetadata) if includeMetadata is not None else False

    chains_rows = _load("chains.json")
    if not isinstance(chains_rows, list):
        chains_rows = []
    chain_row = next((r for r in chains_rows if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("id") == chain), None)
    if not chain_row:
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "chain not found", chain=chain)
        _log("error", e["error"])
        return e

    addresses = _load("addresses.json")
    if not isinstance(addresses, list):
        addresses = []
    assets = _load("assets.json")
    if not isinstance(assets, list):
        assets = []

    addr = token_address.lower()
    addr_row = next((a for a in addresses if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("chain_id") == chain and isinstance(a.get("address"), str) and a.get("address").lower() == addr), None)
    if not addr_row:
        # discovery endpoints: do not create; treat as not found
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "token address not found on this chain", chain_id=chain, token_address=addr)
        _log("error", e["error"], chain_id=chain)
        return e

    token = next((a for a in assets if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("chain_id") == chain and a.get("asset_type") == "erc20" and a.get("contract_address_id") == addr_row.get("id") and a.get("status") != "hidden"), None)
    if not token:
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "token not found on this chain", chain_id=chain, token_address=addr)
        _log("error", e["error"], chain_id=chain)
        return e

    resp = {
        "chain_id": chain,
        "token_address": addr,
        "asset_id": token.get("id"),
        "contract_address_id": token.get("contract_address_id"),
        "name": token.get("name"),
        "symbol": token.get("symbol"),
        "decimals": token.get("decimals"),
        "logo_url": token.get("logo_url"),
        "spam_status": token.get("spam_status"),
        "latest_price_usd": token.get("latest_price_usd"),
        "market_cap_usd": token.get("market_cap_usd"),
        "liquidity_usd": token.get("liquidity_usd"),
        "fdv_usd": token.get("fdv_usd"),
        "status": token.get("status"),
        "metadata": token.get("metadata") if includeMetadata else None,
    }
    _log("ok", meta={"includeMetadata": includeMetadata}, chain_id=chain)
    return resp

tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields of a chain record, including driving allowed lifecycle transitions of `status`. Returns the updated chain. Refuses invalid transitions (e.g. disabled -> degraded) and unknown chain keys.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. "eth", "polygon").

status.description: New lifecycle status for the chain; must be a valid transition from the current status.

displayName.description: Optional display name override for the chain.

nativeSymbol.description: Optional native symbol override (e.g. ETH, MATIC).

category.description: Filter entities by category (exact match as stored).

limit.description: Maximum number of entities to return.
